messages:
michael: Heads-up: next Tue (2026-06-08) were migrating Terraform state from our legacy S3 backend to HashiCorp Cloud (HCP) workspaces and rotating all long-lived service accounts to OIDC short-lived creds. Maintenance window 00:00-08:00 UTC.

michael: Why: reduces secret sprawl, enables fine-grained workspace-level ACLs, and removes the need for org-wide kms keys we keep on runners. Its a security requirement for any infra that stores secrets in state.

tara: Whats the impact for infra owners? Youll need to: migrate backend config, update CI/Terraform runners to request HCP tokens via the new tf-oidc action, and update remote-state consumers.

leo: Any example backend block?

michael: Example hcl snippet:

```
terraform {
  backend "remote" {
    hostname = "app.terraform.io"
    organization = "redwood"
    workspaces { name = "prod-apps" }
  }
}
```

secops: Policy note: all service accounts with direct S3/KMS access will be disabled at cutover. If you need an exception, file a ticket by EOD Mon 2026-06-07.

infra-bot: SCAN: found 64 repositories with `backend "s3"` blocks. Report uploaded to the migration doc.

tara: CI change example (GitHub action):

```
- name: Request OIDC
  id: oidc
  uses: redwood/get-oidc-token@v1
- name: Terraform Init
  run: terraform init -backend-config="protocol=https" -backend-config="hostname=app.terraform.io"
  env:
    HCP_TOKEN: ${{ steps.oidc.outputs.token }}
```

leo: Canary plan? We should migrate infra infra/* first, then platform services, then customer-facing infra.

michael: Canary order: infra/infra-state -> internal-tools/state -> public-services/state. First canary 02:00 UTC with infra/infra-state workspace, monitor apply failures and drift for 90m.

devops-oncall: Rollback knobs: 1) preserve a read-only snapshot of S3 state (immutable) during cutover, 2) re-point specific runners back to s3 backend if critical. We'll keep the toggle for 6h.

secops: After migration well enable workspace policies that deny storing plaintext secrets in state and enforce sentinel checks for provider versions. Teams must run `tfsec` and `checkov` in CI before apply.

tara: For modules that read remote state via `terraform_remote_state`, update the data source to use the HCP workspace endpoint. Example:

```
data "terraform_remote_state" "vpc" {
  backend = "remote"
  config = { organization = "redwood", workspaces = { name = "vpc-prod" } }
}
```

michael: We will publish automated migration scripts that: 1) create HCP workspace, 2) import S3 state as the initial checkpoint, 3) update repo backend config PR. Expect those scripts in #devex later today.

leo: How about service accounts used by Terraform in CI?

secops: Those must stop using long-lived keys. Use OIDC-issued HCP tokens or short-lived ephemeral SA certs. We'll provide a Service Account Migration Guide and an IAM policy template `roles/hcp.tf-apply`.

infra-bot: NOTICE: migration-tool will attempt to validate state imports but will not apply changes. Manual approval required for the final cutover.

devops-oncall: If we see failed applies during the window, oncall will pause the migration and we can roll the repo back to S3 via feature flag. To request rollback, page devops-oncall with the repo name and timestamp.

tara: Owners please: 1) run the scanner output against your repo, 2) test the migration script in a branch, 3) ensure no plaintext secrets in tfstate, 4) ack this thread by EOD Fri 2026-06-05.

michael: Well also rotate the `terraform-operator` service account keys after the migration and require mTLS to talk to the HCP API. Expect increased audit logging.

leo: Any ETA for the conversion tool?

michael: Tool + PR template in #devex in ~2h. I'll post a short runbook with rollback commands and the contact list for oncall.

secops: Reminder: exceptions are temporary and reviewed weekly. Long-term we expect everyone on HCP remote backend.

infra-bot: POLICY: post-cutover compliance check will run 24h after migration and will flag any workspace still linked to S3.

michael: Thanks all. If you want help migrating a large monorepo, ping @michael and well pair. :hammer_and_wrench:
